short: embedded prompts, briefs and profile settings
is: The prompt texts, review briefs, team spawn brief and per-profile Claude settings that app modules compile into the binary with include_str!.
conventions: Brace placeholders ({role}, {pr}, {root}, {instance}, {epic}, {project}, {tasks}, {brief}) are filled by the using module
Assets are compiled in; an edit takes effect only after a rebuild

fs.name: check/
fs.role: critique and security review briefs for runner steps

fs.name: interface.md
fs.role: the zaf interface page: verbs and exit codes

fs.name: keeper.md
fs.role: default keeper prompt for zaf ask

fs.name: profiles/
fs.role: lean and build settings.json for profile init

fs.name: spawn/
fs.role: launch prompts (team, and epic-prompt.txt for planning and the challenger) and the pack standing briefs of team, planning and challenger

notes: Used by: keeper.md in app/ask, interface.md in app/brief, check/ in app/check/step/runner.rs, profiles/ in app/profile, spawn/ in app/spawn
Every plugins/teams brief opens with interface.md's exact bytes for a shared cache prefix; change it and re-paste it there; zaf/tests/pack_briefs.rs fails when one differs
Profile folder names match the profile keys in ZAF.toml [roles] (programmer lean, team build)
